body:
The importer support delivered by #854 preserves explicit modification fields, but source-level curation remains missing. Please recover source-qualified peptidoforms and preparation provenance for **Stražar 2023 (PMID37301199; MSV000089225)** and **Abelin/MAPTAC (PMID31495665)** supplements.

A new audit of the frozen Hitlist2.1.3 canonical MS export (SHA256 `4a739794ab7a21ceb633df6e4cde4c01054f3e53213a5a8dcdc4d78604dde58f`, 5,440,019 rows) found **305,607 class-II observations with usable condition annotations deferred for unknown peptidoform status**. This is a curation/coverage bottleneck, not a benchmark result. Whole-export earlier admission also retained unknown status for 535,026 supplementary rows across conditions/classes.

The issue remains visible in current source `43e2266`: `strazar_2023_hla2.csv` has only `peptide,mhc_class,mhc_restriction`, and its `supplementary.yaml` entry supplies no reviewed peptidoform contract. It is a current-study subset of a compiled training table, not the original PSM/form table; existing deduplication scope must be preserved.

The [original Stražar paper](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10519123/) reports iodoacetamide in immunopeptidomics preparation, fixed cysteine carbamidomethylation in search, multiple variable modifications, and publicly deposited PSMs in MSV000089225. Thus neither “all uppercase means unmodified” nor “all identified modifications were present during binding” is defensible. Native ligand chemistry and preparation-induced derivatization need distinct provenance. Full text was recovered through the NCBI BioC endpoint after PMC/EuropePMC retrieval failures; raw-retrieval SHA256 `29536930bd0592fffbdfd6a249eeba78654da58d26cfc98b27074389b8ab61d4`.

Acceptance criteria:

- Join original identified forms/PSMs to supplement peptide–MHC rows with exact source/run/sheet/row keys and ambiguity dispositions. Preserve multiple forms and observed modifications/sites, not just canonical sequences.
- Record preparation chemistry and its timing separately from known biological modification status. A source-wide policy needs a primary-source citation and explicit scope; variable/search options alone do not prove individual observed forms.
- Preserve explicit unmodified, modified, and unresolved cases through contributors and training exports using the #854 support. Do not blanket-fill missing `has_ptm=False` or force one form when multiple forms contribute.
- Keep the current-study subset separate from reused IEDB/Abelin rows, prediction-based deconvolution and generated decoys. Report recovered row counts and genuinely additional independent observations separately.
- Add source fixtures and original-row replay; quantify the eligible unmodified subset and any explicitly defined sequence-level aggregation that remains scientifically appropriate for MS observation outputs. Do not silently aggregate modified pMHCs into unmodified affinity measurements.

Presto's common condition adapter is ready to retain the source facts. Current audit/reproduction: `experiments/2026-11-10_1431_codex_ms-condition-contrasts/`; pirl-unc/presto#155 tracks the subsequent condition-aware fit. This follow-up separates unfinished source curation from the already completed importer fix in #854.
title: Recover source peptidoforms and preparation provenance for Strazar/MAPTAC MS supplements
